reviewList.badText:
This has been a part of my routine just a few days shy of 4 weeks but I find it too early to comment on anything other than this being a convenient and easy product to use. 

A lot of the benefits to be seen are ones that require long term use and consistency so I plan to stick it out for that.
reviewList.goodText:
ᴍɪʀᴀᴄʟᴇ ᴀɢᴇ ᴍᴇʟᴀᴡʀɪɴɢ ᴅᴜᴀʟ ʙᴀʟᴍ (10g)

A multi-purpose balm stick that promises to banish blemish, improve wrinkles and skin elasticity. 

✔️ reduce lines and wrinkles
✔️ improve elasticity and firmness 
✔️ provide brightening, lifting and moisturizing benefits 

◾️ ɴᴏᴛᴀʙʟᴇ ɪɴɢʀᴇᴅɪᴇɴᴛꜱ: Lactobacillus Ferment, Pancratium Maritimum Extract, Lespedeza Capitata Leaf/Stem Extract, Argania Spinosa Kernel Oil, Allantoin & Centella Asiatica Extract 

Unlike the other multi-balms most of us have seen, this one is formed whole by an inner white center and a wide yellow ring surrounding it. The yellow portion of the balm is responsible for boosting glow, moisturizing and improving skin tone where as the white center is tasked with wrinkle care.

Personally this took the least amount of time to break in out of all the stick balms I tried. It gave me a nice buttery glide early on in comparison to the other ones. Despite leaving a glowy finish on some, I get a full on shine wherever I apply this so I prefer to apply this in the evening when I’m less fussed about looking ridiculously reflective and shiny. 

It does deposit moisturization to my under eye area so it has for the time being replaced my eye cream at night. I also use it on my forehead, cheeks, smile and neck lines. 

This is something I think those with dry skin would be able to enjoy more.
